name: Lamb Stuffed Spaghetti Squash
ingredients: 5 cloves – Garlic (4 minced and 1 grated), divided
instructions: Brush each half squash with 1⁄2 Tbsp olive oil; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Flip squash cut sides down and poke holes into the skins with a fork. Roast 35-40 minutes, until tender.
Meanwhile, toast the pine nuts in a skillet over medium heat until lightly browned. They brown quickly so don’t leave them. Remove from the skillet immediately.

Add the remaining olive oil to the skillet. Add the lamb and crumble. Cook until browned over medium heat. Add most garlic, cumin, paprika, turmeric, cayenne, and half of salt/pepper. Add the chickpeas and diced tomatoes. Stir to combine. Add the spinach and stir to wilt into the mixture.
While the lamb mixture simmers, stir together the yogurt, lemon juice, remaining salt/pepper, and the remaining garlic clove.
Once the squash is tender, remove from the oven and fluff with a fork. Fill each half with a quarter of the lamb mixture and top with yogurt.
Serve with toasted Pine Nuts and Cilantro.
